youth.title: Youth Confidence Track
youth.summary: Calm, structured 2-minute movement drills designed for safe living room practice and parent-child confidence building.

modules.title: The Ready Stance & Personal Space Bubble
modules.mechanicalKey: Flexed knees, rooted center of gravity, palms forming an upright defensive shield.
modules.homeDrill: The Mountain Stance balance game against gentle parent palm checks (30 seconds).
modules.parentCue: Look for relaxed shoulders and rooted footing.

modules.title: Rocking Chair & Gentle Breakfalls
modules.mechanicalKey: Chin tucked to chest, curved spine, palms striking the carpet at 45 degrees.
modules.homeDrill: Rocking smoothly on a soft carpet without head contact with the floor.
modules.parentCue: Ask your child to watch their belt knot as they rock back.

modules.title: Safe Distance & Feet on Hips
modules.mechanicalKey: Feet placed softly on partner hip points to maintain a comfortable space boundary.
modules.homeDrill: The Distance Bubble game using couch cushions as gentle targets.
modules.parentCue: Guide knees to stay springy like shock absorbers.

modules.title: The Carpet Shrimp (Hip Escape)
modules.mechanicalKey: Turn to one shoulder hip line, plant one foot, slide hips cleanly backward.
modules.homeDrill: Five smooth carpet shrimps across the living room rug.
modules.parentCue: Praise smooth movement rather than speed.

modules.title: Technical Standup with Protective Shield
modules.mechanicalKey: Rear hand posts under shoulder, front hand forms high shield, rear leg steps wide.
modules.homeDrill: Ten slow, balanced technical standups maintaining eye contact forward.
modules.parentCue: Ensure the protective shield hand remains active until standing.

modules.title: Head & Neck Comfort in the Clinch
modules.mechanicalKey: Biceps frame inside collar line, spine tall, hips connected close to partner.
modules.homeDrill: Mirror posture drill against parent palms.

modules.title: Airplane Balance Against Gentle Checks
modules.mechanicalKey: Wide knee placement, weight distributed evenly across shins and toes.
modules.homeDrill: Airplane Balance hold while parent gently checks shoulders.
modules.parentCue: Check for calm breathing and steady posture.

modules.title: The Butterfly Elevator Sweep
modules.mechanicalKey: Deep underhook, head placed under partner chin, foot hook lifts smoothly.
modules.homeDrill: Lifting a couch cushion or plush toy with the top of one foot.
modules.parentCue: Celebrate smooth timing over physical pushing.

modules.title: Elbow-Knee Connection from the Side
modules.mechanicalKey: Forearm frame on hip line, bottom elbow and knee touching as a solid shield.
modules.homeDrill: Solo frame curl on the carpet holding position for 5 seconds.
modules.parentCue: The elbow and knee form an unbreakable team.

modules.title: Mount Calm & The Underhook Bridge
modules.mechanicalKey: Elbows protecting ribs, trapping one side, bridging hips toward the ceiling.
modules.homeDrill: Solo bridge hold touching ceiling with palms for 3 seconds.
modules.parentCue: Deep belly breaths keep the mind clear.

modules.title: The Gentle Backpack (Back Control Seatbelt)
modules.mechanicalKey: Chest-to-back connection, diagonal seatbelt harness, supportive hooks.
modules.homeDrill: Plush bear backpack hold demonstrating covered hand grip.
modules.parentCue: Real control is quiet and steady.

modules.title: The Ribbon of Confidence (12-Week Review)
modules.mechanicalKey: Linking base, distance management, and gentle control into one fluid flow.
modules.homeDrill: Two-minute living room family demonstration.
modules.parentCue: Celebrate your child's consistency and earned stripe milestone.

adult.title: Adult Start Calm Track
adult.summary: Biomechanically sound 2-minute video breakdowns focusing on structural alignment, nervous system calm, and pure mechanical leverage.

modules.title: The Mountaintop Defensive Frame & Diaphragmatic Breath
modules.mechanicalKey: Structural bone alignment replaces muscular exertion; 4-second nasal inhale, 6-second exhale.
modules.homeDrill: Prone wall framing hold (2 minutes) focusing on shoulder relaxation.
modules.coachingCue: Let your skeletal geometry carry the weight so your muscles remain fresh.

modules.title: Closed Guard Posture & Safe Inside Ties
modules.mechanicalKey: Tucked pelvis, stacked lumbar spine, hands monitoring biceps and hip crease.
modules.homeDrill: Counterbalance bodyweight squat hold against doorframe (60 seconds).
modules.coachingCue: Looking straight forward preserves your spinal alignment effortlessly.

modules.title: The Mechanical Hip Escape (Restoring Guard)
modules.mechanicalKey: Forearm across hip line, shoulder pivot, hips driving 45 degrees backward.
modules.homeDrill: Solo floor shrimp with hands crossed over chest to isolate hip drive.
modules.coachingCue: Move your hips away from your partner instead of trying to push them away.

modules.title: Mount Survival & The Mechanical Upa Bridge
modules.mechanicalKey: Trap arm and foot on same side, deep hip extension through heels at 45 degrees.
modules.homeDrill: Glute bridge hold with single-shoulder rotation (8 reps each side).
modules.coachingCue: A high bridge creates the angle; the roll follows naturally.

modules.title: Side Control Defense & The Elbow-Knee Wedge
modules.mechanicalKey: Near-side forearm on neck line, far-side on hip, bottom knee sliding inside as a wedge.
modules.homeDrill: Wall knee-insertion drill on yoga mat.
modules.coachingCue: Create the structural wedge first; your guard rebuilds itself behind it.

modules.title: Technical Standup & Level Change Protection
modules.mechanicalKey: Three base points, post directly under shoulder line, wide rear leg sweep.
modules.homeDrill: Ten slow, balanced technical standups per side.
modules.coachingCue: Maintain your protective frame until both feet are planted.

modules.title: Back Defense & Two-on-One Grip Control
modules.mechanicalKey: Two hands controlling the choking arm at wrist and forearm, sliding hips to safe side.
modules.homeDrill: Wall slide escape sequence isolating hip angle rotation.
modules.coachingCue: Control the wrist first; space opens as your hips rotate to the floor.

modules.title: Half Guard Underhook Recovery & Knee Shield
modules.mechanicalKey: Top knee shield across chest, bottom arm fishing deep underhook to rise to elbow.
modules.homeDrill: Solo elbow-post hip scoot across mat.
modules.coachingCue: Getting off your flat back onto your side cuts partner pressure in half.

modules.title: Standing Clinch & Collar-Tie Neutralization
modules.mechanicalKey: Biceps bump inside collar-tie, head posted on partner collarbone, hips square.
modules.homeDrill: Mirror posture drill maintaining level eye contact.
modules.coachingCue: Head position controls the exchange; keep your chin tucked and neck tall.

modules.title: Turtle Defense & Safe Guard Reconstitution
modules.mechanicalKey: Elbows connected to knees, chin tucked, sit-out rotation toward open mat.
modules.homeDrill: Solo sit-out rotation on carpet.
modules.coachingCue: Keep your defensive shell tight until your hip rotates through to face your partner.

modules.title: Controlled Joint Mechanics: Pure Mechanical Leverage
modules.mechanicalKey: Isolate the joint above and below, using whole-body core alignment instead of arm strength.
modules.homeDrill: Wooden dowel fulcrum lever drill demonstrating mechanical advantage.
modules.coachingCue: Applied with care and patience, leverage allows safe training for decades.

modules.title: The Start Calm Flow: Integrating 12 Weeks of Motion
modules.mechanicalKey: Flowing smoothly from defense to guard, to sweep, to control with relaxed nasal breathing.
modules.homeDrill: Three-minute continuous solo movement circuit.
modules.coachingCue: Notice how natural and calm the positions feel now compared to your first class.
